title: 1999 Skybox Dominion Lamarr Glenn Terry Jackson #239 Rookie RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1999 Skybox Dominion trading card features Lamarr Glenn, Terry Jackson, and Jackson's rookie card attributes. The card is an original and comes from the manufacturer Fleer/Skybox. It is a single card from the set and has the card number 239. The card is a sports trading card for football fans and collectors. It is an original card from the 1999 season and features no parallel or variety. The card is a great addition to any collection for fans of the San Francisco 49ers or Lamarr Glenn.
